comment: M13 #405 regression budgets. Ceilings are reviewed ceilings, not targets — changes are a reviewable diff. Lane values are wall-clock seconds measured by scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs on the CI runner.

dist.comment: Sum of packages/*/dist + apps/*/dist, checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs dist after a full build.

dependencies.comment: Unique external package@version pairs from `bun pm ls --all`; #405 counted 274 at c37de22 with 6 known duplicated-major transitive pairs.

startup.comment: Cold start to /ready for apps/local-control-plane on a developer host; measured by the documented probe, not wired into CI.

rss.comment: Main-process peak RSS at idle after ready; measured by the documented probe, not wired into CI. Re-evaluate sizing whenever marketplace artifact budgets change (#194 rule).
